## Activity

During June 2026, North City Eye Clinic recorded 535 captures. This activity represents the imaging completed at the site during the month. The result is reported for operational monitoring and provides the basis for reviewing image quality and grading outcomes.

Staff raised no new equipment faults this month. The site should continue to record and report any equipment issues through the usual operational arrangements so that they can be reviewed promptly.

## Image quality

Of the 535 captures, 9 were ungradable. This corresponds to an ungradable rate of 1.7 per cent. The ungradable captures could not be assessed for grading purposes. The image quality result should continue to be monitored alongside routine site activity, with any recurring issues considered through local review.

## Grading

A total of 146 results were graded referable. The median grading wait was 1 day. This measure records the time taken for grading and should be considered alongside the number of captures and the ungradable rate. Together, these results provide a summary of activity, image quality and grading performance at North City Eye Clinic for June 2026.
